text:
Aisha (partnerships): quick sync — shiproom 3pm PT today. primary asks: who owns the press slot review, final landing CTA, and SI preview? we need to lock embargo and fallback messaging by EOD.
Marco (marketing): I can own press slot review. will sync with comms and draft hero quote. sending draft by 1:30pm. :thumbsup:
Devon (product): landing page is deployed to staging (staging.redwood.com/marketplace). blocked on partner-provided integration diagram and logo asset (SVG preferred). can we get those by noon?
Sam (solutions): SI preview — we can stand up demo env tomorrow AM if partners give test creds today. also need a 15min run-through script.
Priya (legal): legal needs final approved quotes by 5pm PT today to include in the press release. embargo window ok? confirm exact embargo datetime so we lock the clause.
Aisha (partnerships): embargo set to Tue 10:00am PT. partners must confirm final copy + assets by Mon 5:00pm PT or we default to 'coming soon' messaging. fallback noted.
Marco (marketing): noted. I'll prepare a short 'fallback' hero and CTA that doesn't reference partner details. will queue both variants in the CMS.
Devon (product): for the integration diagram please provide: 1) authentication flow, 2) data path, 3) expected latency. small SVG diagram is fine.
Sam (solutions): @Aisha can you ping the SI partner and request sandbox creds + a tech lead for the run-through? i'll draft the 15min script now.
Aisha (partnerships): will ping now. @ops-bot please create a shiproom task and assign owners.
ops-bot: created ticket RED-PL-9812: "Marketplace launch — press + SI handoff" assigned to Marco/Devon/Sam, due 2024-07-22 17:00 PT. link: https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/RED-PL-9812
Priya (legal): quick note — avoid partner financial metrics in the quote unless partner explicitly provides and signs off. otherwise we need legal review which will delay.
Marco (marketing): thanks — will ask partners for signed quote approval. if we don't get it, I'll use a product-led quote from our PM.
Devon (product): small QA ask — staging page shows a token error when the partner logo is missing. i'll add a graceful placeholder today. low risk.
Sam (solutions): draft run-through uploaded: https://drive.redwood.com/si-runbooks/marketplace-demo-v1.md — teams can comment.
Aisha (partnerships): checklist summary (copying into thread):
```
- Press slot review: Marco (due 1:30pm)
- Assets (logo, diagram): Partner -> due noon
- Quotes approval: Partner -> Priya to review -> due 5pm
- Landing page fallback CTA: Marco -> draft done by 2pm
- SI preview env + creds: Partner -> Sam -> demo ready tomorrow AM
- Shiproom ticket: RED-PL-9812
- Embargo: Tue 10:00am PT
```
Marco (marketing): LGTM. i'll post the draft quote in this thread when ready.
Aisha (partnerships): perfect — please ping if any owner misses deadlines. otherwise we'll reconvene at shiproom 3pm. :calendar: 
Marco (marketing): draft quote posted: "Partnering with Redwood Inference to bring low-latency, scalable LLM inference to customers." tagging @Priya for signoff.
Priya (legal): approved except remove 'low-latency' claim unless we add a supporting benchmark link. suggest: remove claim or replace with 'production-ready performance'.
Marcus (marketing): (typo) Marco meant to say — updated and reposting.
Sam (solutions): got creds from partner, demo env standing up now. will confirm within 30m.
Aisha (partnerships): thanks everyone. final call: if all assets + quote are approved by 5pm PT today, proceed with embargoed press release for Tue 10am PT. otherwise, we flip to fallback messaging and postpone partner quote.
Marco (marketing): roger.
Devon (product): i'll drop the placeholder logo patch in prod by EOD.
Sam (solutions): demo confirmed up at 1765435800, run-through scheduled for tomorrow 9am PT.
Aisha (partnerships): last message before shiproom: please add any blockers here and i'll escalate.
Marco (marketing): no blockers from comms. :white_check_mark:
